div.head: Quadr II 17.3
div.ab: Quod ad noticiam uenture posteritatis et memoriam debite ueritatis sincera deuotione recensui, debitas ei ferians exequias et sacra uitulamina faciens, non omentis pinguibus, sed iustis bone uoluntatis affectibus illustrata.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 546 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

seg.hi: hieraus erhellt deutlich des Verfassers Verpflichtung gegen Gerhard

note.seg: this clearly shows the author’s obligation to Gerard
nicht ‘üppige Weinranken’ (in Vulg. Sap. 3, 4), sondern wohl aus Marob. Sat. 3, 2: faciam uitula, nomen sacrificii, denn omenta: ‘Eingeweide [der Opferthiere]’
not ‘luxuriant vine-shoots’ (in Vulg. Sap. 3, 4), but probably from Marob. Sat. 3, 2: faciam uitula, nomen sacrificii, since omenta: ‘entrails [of the sacrificial animals]’
